### Architecture Overview

```
[Payment Provider]
       │
       ▼ (10k req/s HTTPS)
[Ingress Gateway (Stateless Go/Rust)]
       │
       ├─ Verify HMAC Signature
       ├─ Format-validate payload
       ▼
[Kafka Cluster: topic `webhook-raw`]
       │ (Partitioned by provider:payment_id)
       ▼
[Webhook Processor Workers]
       │
       ├─ Tier 1: Per-Key In-Memory / Partition Serialization
